reports.title: Mike Lindell's Lawyers Fined for AI-Generated Fake Citations
reports.summary: MyPillow creator Mike Lindell's lawyers were fined thousands of dollars for submitting a legal filing riddled with AI-generated mistakes, including case citations that were not real. The lawyers were sanctioned for submitting motions and other court filings filled with case citations that are not real and were created by generative AI.
reports.impact: Legal documents contained fabricated information, undermining the integrity of the court proceedings.
